exact_statement: For every block A and every map e from subsets of C=[n]\A to subsets of A: (ln 2) J_A <= 2 E|S_A symdiff e(S_C)|, J_A = I(X;Y) in bits. With e the conditional majority, (ln 2) J_A <= 2 beta_A where beta_A = sum_{i in A} E min(p_i(S_C), 1-p_i(S_C)), p_i(T) = P(i in S | S_C = T); and 2 beta_A <= sum_{i in A} H(Z_i | S_C).
hypotheses: f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}, n>=1, A nonempty subset of [n], S ~ fhat^2, X uniform on {-1,1}^A, Y|X=a ~ (f_a)hat^2, entropies in bits
proof_source: REPORT.md section 3 (fibrewise Gross log-Sobolev Ent(g^2) <= 2 sum|U| ghat(U)^2 applied to chi_{e(T)} w_T)

exact_statement: If f is a dimension-critical C-witness then for every nonempty proper block A: C I_A + D_C(f) <= H(Z_A|Z_C) + (2/ln2) beta_A. For a singleton i: C Inf_i + D_C(f) <= H(Z_i|Z_-i) + (2/ln2) beta_i, where beta_i is the Bayes error of predicting Z_i from Z_-i, beta_i <= min(Inf_i, 1-Inf_i, eps_u for every u containing i, H(Z_i|Z_-i)/2); hence H(Z_i|Z_-i) >= (C Inf_i + D_C(f))/(1+1/ln2) > 0, so no coordinate's spectral membership is a function of the rest of the spectral sample. This implies A052's rank-one bound C Inf_i + D_C <= h2(eps_u) + (2/ln2) eps_u.
hypotheses: D_C(f) = H(f) - C I(f) > 0 and H(g) <= C I(g) for every Boolean g on fewer than n coordinates; eps_u = (1-|E f(x)f(x xor u)|)/2

exact_statement: Let phi(f) = min over nonempty proper blocks A with I_A>0 of L_A/I_A and K_desc(n) = max over nonconstant f on n bits of phi(f). Then K_desc(2)=4, K_desc(3)=4.433834373377398591729..., K_desc(4)=4.536634068264783227945..., and M_n = max H/I equals 2, 2.955889582251599061152..., 3.402475551198587420958...; for n=2,3,4 both maxima are attained exactly at the 2^(n+1) point defects. Runner-up values at n=4: phi 3.13158, H/I 2.95589.
proof_source: out/exhaustive_n2_4.json, out/certify_n2_4.json; exhaustive float64 scan in which weights and influences are exact dyadic rationals and the only inexact operation is log2 (gaps 1.40 and 0.45 exceed any log2 error by >10^9); point-defect values by mpmath interval arithmetic at 120 bits from closed forms
